answer: Each epoch 40 hollow slots go to auction. An identity seals its bid in onyx and claims a hollow cell; the lantern reveals all bids, and the top 40 win. Losers pay a 5-credit fee, winners lock a 70-credit bond. The first fake costs 55 plus a 70 lock; 1,000 fakes cost 125,000 against a 40,000 pool. A bid-pooling ring fails: one wallet cluster behind many bids is exposed on the lantern graph, voided. An honest agent pays 55 once, keeps its slot.
